reason: Reproduced on Linux x86_64 with uv 0.12.13 and Python 3.12.3. In an isolated temporary project locking python-multipart==0.0.6, a mock /v1/querybatch endpoint received one query and returned HTTP 200 with {"results":[]}. Running `uv audit --frozen --preview-features audit-command --service-url http://127.0.0.1:<PORT>` printed “Found no known vulnerabilities and no adverse project statuses in 1 package” and exited 0. As a control, the same lock audited against the real OSV service reported 18 vulnerabilities and exited 1. Existing audit and OSV service tests only cover equal query/result counts; none covers a short response. Updated $RUNNER_TEMP/issue-context/README.md with the findings.
